exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-1
Adequate renal function defined as creatinine clearance ≥ 30mL/min by Cockcroft-Gault equation
Adequate hepatic function defined as serum total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN, AST/ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN (or ≤ 5 × ULN in patients with liver metastases)
exclusions.threshold: bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN; AST/ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN (≤ 5 × ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Patient is a pregnant or lactating WOCBP
Patients with evidence of active hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV) or human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection.
History of primary malignancy other than the malignancy under study will be excluded, except for malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death (e.g., 5-year OS rate >90%).
Symptomatic or uncontrolled central nervous system and brain metastasis or active leptomeningeal disease.

Congestive heart failure (> New York Heart Association Class II), active coronary artery disease, unevaluated new onset angina within 3 months or unstable angina (angina symptoms at rest) or clinically significant cardiac arrhythmias
QTc interval (using Fridericia correction calculation) > 480 msec
